text: Two men are stranded. Water, but zero food. Who lasts longer?
Body fat is stored food: one pound holds about thirty-five hundred calories, almost two days of energy.
But the body also burns muscle, even the heart. Fat buys time, not forever.
The record? A Scottish man fasted three hundred eighty-two days, with doctors watching, and lost two hundred seventy-six pounds.
Fat isn't just weight. It's a backup tank.
